notes.title: Noch - First Chapter
notes.content:
First 3 hours of mysterious adventure in deceased world starting now! 
Fourth project of Fair Games. And again we will say that we collected all experience from previous projects to put it into something new. 

Shortly Noch is an ominous surreal first-person adventure full of dangerous monsters and secrets of the deceased world. But who can tell what is the reason that everything falling apart? Why all you have in your head is that Lisa disappeared and you have to save her no matter what? Is it coincidence? Or maybe the reason is deeper and you have to dig a little and find the Truth? 

First chapter already available on Steam! Co-op mode for 2 players is included! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1363360?utm_source=protocol]Link on a project [/url]

notes.title: Game Protocol is about to release for consoles!
notes.content:
It seems that we have jumped over our heads. Fair Games studio's first project Protocol is available for pre-order on Xbox. And on April 30 you can establish contact with an alien life form in a new format. Prepare your controllers!

Of course Protocol is still available on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/724490/Protocol/

notes.title: Trigon Space story announcement
notes.content:
Here it is! An unexpected, long-awaited and very cool announcement.

Sernur.tech in collaboration with Fair Games Studio work on awesome space roguelike game with tactical combat, social elements, co-op and other cool stuff, like multi-enemy fights. With quests, caravans and tough moral choices. It is your special epic adventure in space.

Project grows with coolest production from Sernur.tech and game design and producing from us, right in a heart of Mari-El forests (check where it is - it’s awesome!), in a great town Yoshkar-Ola (try to say it correct) ;) 

The guys are very tough! IWe’re proud of them!

Current stage: alpha, preparation for Early Access.

Where it will be: Steam first, then everything else 

Wishlist it and follow here https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226510/Trigon_Space_Story/

[previewyoutube=VYh6oUzhbDc;full][/previewyoutube]
